title: The Twin-Court Naginata Canon
summary: A canon of the twin-court school in which every long stroke is answered by a paired stroke from the qi field.

title: Hawk and Azure Long-Blade Doctrine
summary: A doctrine of hunting arcs and stooping cuts for the hawk school ending in one blinking descent.

title: Paired Reaping of the Basin
summary: A short elite text on reaping in paired basin-shaped arcs that overturn a foe who stands on level ground.

title: River-Run Naginata Doctrine
summary: A doctrine of following the run of a river from ford to cataract so one long edge never loses its flow.

title: Treatise of the Dual-Track Long Edge
summary: A large treatise on running two tracks of attack side by side along the shaft and crossing them at the kill.

title: Azure Wheel Sweep Teachings
summary: Teachings on turning the whole stance like a wheel so that sweep and guard are one unbroken motion.

title: The Twin Hawk Crescent Forms
summary: Forms for two crescents cast like a pair of hawks hunting together then falling on one target.

title: Wind-Sworn Long Blade Doctrine
summary: A doctrine for the wind-sworn who cut with the wind at their back and cast a sweep that reaches the sky.

title: Plateau Oath Naginata Canon
summary: A short canon that ties each stroke to an oath sworn on the high ground and releases it as one wide sweep.

title: Treatise of the Open Bearing Sweep
summary: A treatise on holding an open bearing through the sweep so that the wielder is never boxed in.

title: No-Wall Naginata Teachings
summary: Teachings for fighting with no wall behind and no retreat planned only forward sweeps that give no ground.

title: Gale-Edge Doctrine of the Long Reach
summary: A large doctrine of reach for the gale-edge school from the first stance to a horizon-wide blinking cut.

title: The Oathbound Sweep Canon
summary: A canon of sweeps that the wielder is bound by oath to complete and to answer for.

title: Windline Naginata Forms
summary: Forms that follow the line of the wind across the plateau with cuts that burst along that line.
